title: Rust: FizzBuzz
description: Implement the classic FizzBuzz interview problem in Rust.

steps.title: Print 1 to 15
steps.description: Print the numbers from 1 to 15 in a loop.
hints: The `..=` syntax includes the end value.
Just print each number for now.

steps.title: Fizz for Multiples of 3
steps.description: Modify your loop: if the number is divisible by 3, print `"Fizz"` instead of the number.
hints: The first numbers should be: 1, 2, Fizz, 4, 5, Fizz, ...

steps.title: Buzz for Multiples of 5
hints: 15 is divisible by both 3 and 5 — it should print 'FizzBuzz'.

steps.title: FizzBuzz for Both
steps.description: Now handle the case where a number is divisible by both 3 and 5 — print `"FizzBuzz"`. The order matters: check both first!
hints: Otherwise check 3, then 5, then print the number.

verification.failureMessage: Print 'FizzBuzz' for numbers divisible by both 3 and 5.

steps.title: FizzBuzz Up to 30
steps.description: Run the full FizzBuzz logic from 1 to 30. Print each result on its own line.
hints: Keep the same logic from step 4.
